remarks: Live the Cove lifestyle! Welcome to this bright and sunny 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath ranch-style condo offering over 1,200 square feet of comfortable living in the highly desirable Cove Island Park neighborhood-just a short stroll to the beach, park, and scenic walking trails. This inviting home features a spacious living and dining room combination with a wood-burning fireplace and triple sliders that open to an over-sized private balcony, creating the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. The open layout is complemented by abundant closet space throughout. Additional highlights include an in-unit washer and dryer, a large private storage area, and access to a residents' Gym located in the common room. The unit includes one reserved covered parking space, plus an additional unassigned spot along the back fence. All of this is just minutes from Chelsea Piers, Terry Connors Ice Rink, local dining and shopping, I-95, the Stamford train station, and everything the vibrant City of Stamford has to offer. Please, all offers on binder of sale or purchase agreement ONLY. No love letter or escalation clauses
